label: llm-cart-failure
alert: Traffic spike on frontend: 14.536 req/s vs baseline 2.749 [ongoing 13 min]; Traffic spike on frontend-proxy: 14.968 req/s vs baseline 2.615 [ongoing 14 min]; Operation POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart on cart failing: error rate 13%
summary: The cart service is intermittently failing to connect to its Redis cache, causing checkout failures during a period of high traffic.
symptoms: Traffic spike on frontend and frontend-proxy.
Checkout service failing due to cart service errors.

root_cause.description: The cart service is intermittently failing to connect to its Redis cache (valkey-cart) under increased load, leading to FailedPrecondition errors in the EmptyCart operation.

evidence.quote: Status(StatusCode=\"FailedPrecondition\", Detail=\"Can't access cart storage. System.ApplicationException: Wasn't able to connect to redis
evidence.explanation: The cart service is failing to empty the cart due to a connection error with Redis.
The cart service logs confirm it cannot connect to Redis.
evidence.quote: Wasn't able to connect to redis

evidence.explanation: The frontend and frontend-proxy are experiencing a traffic spike, which is likely causing the load on the cart service and subsequent failures when it cannot reach its dependency.

ruled_out: The valkey-cart container itself appears healthy and is not resource-constrained.
The checkout service errors are a direct consequence of the cart service failures.

proposed_action.reason: The cart service is failing due to increased load causing Redis connection issues. Throttling the load generator will reduce the pressure on the cart service and its cache.
proposed_action.expected_outcome: Reduction in traffic to the cart service, allowing it to recover from Redis connection failures.

prevention: Implement circuit breaking and better retry logic in the cart service when Redis is unavailable. Investigate why the traffic spike is causing intermittent connectivity issues to the Redis cache.
